bio: I am a very enthusiastic person about new technologies. I love computer science and I am always interested in learning new things. I am hardworking and responsible.
aboutLong:
I'm a **Game Developer and Technical Artist based in Barcelona**, currently studying Design and Development of Video Games and Serious Games at ENTI-UB.

I specialize in **Unreal Engine**, working across gameplay programming, systems development and technical art. I enjoy building robust gameplay systems and bridging programming and visuals through tools such as **Blueprints, C++, Niagara and Unreal's Material Editor**.

I'm especially interested in **gameplay programming, technical art and systems-driven development**, and I'm always looking for new challenges where I can combine technical problem-solving with creative development.
